name: hikari-pool-timeout

name: pg-connection-slots
incident: psql: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections. Requests failing to acquire a connection from the pool.

name: oomkilled-137

incident: p99 latency spiked to 4s, upstream timeouts, thread pool saturation climbing after the 14:00 deploy.

name: gateway-timeout-queue
incident: Clients getting 504 Gateway Timeout, requests queuing, slow responses across the API, throughput dropping.

name: disk-full
incident: Writes failing with No space left on device. df -h shows /var at 100%. Log shipping stalled and the database went read-only.

name: cert-expired
incident: curl: SSL certificate problem: certificate has expired. Services report x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid; TLS handshake failing.

name: kafka-lag
incident: Kafka consumer group lag increasing, records-lag-max high, consumers falling behind and rebalancing repeatedly.
